title: MeatUp
overview: MeatUp is a cross-platform mobile commerce application designed to simplify online meat ordering with a seamless customer experience. The application combines intuitive mobile interfaces with scalable backend services, enabling users to browse products, place orders, and track purchases efficiently.
challenge: Traditional meat ordering relies heavily on phone calls and local vendors, making inventory management and order tracking inefficient. The challenge was to digitize this workflow into a responsive mobile experience.
goal: Build a scalable mobile application capable of handling authentication, product management, cart operations, and real-time order synchronization while maintaining a smooth user experience.
solution: Developed a React Native application powered by Node.js APIs and Firebase services. Designed reusable UI components, integrated authentication, optimized backend communication, and implemented responsive mobile screens for Android devices.
result: Delivered a production-ready Android application with a scalable architecture, seamless authentication flow, and responsive shopping experience.

title: MeatUp
mentor: Sravya Renish, Officer at Federal Bank
overview: MeatUp is a modern e-commerce platform designed to simplify the online purchase of fresh meat and related products. The platform enables customers to browse products, place orders, securely manage their accounts, and track purchases through an intuitive and responsive web experience.
challenge: Traditional meat vendors often rely on manual ordering methods, resulting in poor inventory visibility, inefficient order management, and limited customer convenience. The objective was to digitize the complete ordering workflow while ensuring scalability and ease of use.
goal: Build a fast, responsive, and scalable web application that streamlines online meat ordering, improves customer experience, and provides efficient order and product management.
solution: Designed and developed a complete full-stack web application with a modern React frontend, RESTful Node.js backend, and Firebase-powered authentication and database services. The application focuses on responsive design, optimized user journeys, and efficient data synchronization.
responsibilities: Implemented product catalogue and shopping cart
result: Successfully delivered a scalable e-commerce platform that digitizes the complete online meat ordering process. The application provides an intuitive shopping experience, efficient backend management, secure authentication, and a responsive interface across desktop and mobile devices.
